title: Uber Freight reportedly investigating after hacking group claims data breach | TechCrunch
summary: In a post on its data leak site, which it uses to host the stolen files, the Helix hackers claim to have taken mailboxes, cloud storage drives, files relating to accounts payable and dispatch documents from Uber Freight.
